text:
Maya: @here Elevated 5xx/503 errors observed in hosted-east-1 for large-model generation (high-context jobs). Customers running >32k token requests seeing aborts. Initial detection 14:02 UTC. Incident page: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1824005000

Simon: Investigating. Spike in memory on p4d pool; autoscaler attempted to add nodes but several pods OOM'd before readiness. Pattern looks like KV cache growth + continuous batching for long sequences.

Aaron: Action taken: disabled prefix KV caching for large-context models, rolled back runtime kernel patch 'runt-2026-11-01' -> previous stable. Manually scaled east-1 serving pool +4 nodes. Rolling update started. ETA 12-18m.

deploy-bot: Rollback deployment 'runtime/runt-2026-11-01' -> 'runt-2026-10-28' completed at 14:09 UTC. All rollout hooks passed.

Eli: Support: opened cases for 7 affected workspaces; proactively notified top 3 customers. Short-term workaround shared: set max_context_length=32768 or switch to chunked streaming for long jobs. Will DM affected teams.

Simon: Metrics update: 5xx rate down ~70% from peak after mitigations. Still seeing intermittent 502s for very long requests. Traces: https://traces.redwood.internal/trace/abc123

Maya: Current status: partial service restored for most customers. hosted-east-1 remains degraded for heavyweight long-sequence workloads. No customer data loss. Next check-in in 30m. Postmortem owner: @aaron-sre. If you see critical customer pings, route to #support-urgents.

Aaron: Postmortem draft: https://confluence.redwood/postmortems/1824005000-kernel-ooms — will add root cause analysis and remediation tasks (autoscaler backoff, KV cache upper-bound, enhanced canary for kernel changes).

Maya: Thanks team. Will update when east-1 is green or if any rollback is required. :white_check_mark:
